summary: Sabesp and EMAE disclosed that EMAE shareholders approved, at an extraordinary shareholders' meeting, the merger of all EMAE shares not held by Sabesp into Sabesp. Sabesp will issue 1.31950000000 common shares per EMAE common or preferred share under the June 29, 2026 Protocol. Sabesp shareholders approved the deal on July 30, 2026. Withdrawal rights run for EMAE holders continuously invested since the April 23, 2026 cutoff; fractional Sabesp shares will be aggregated and sold on B3. Watch completion mechanics, appraisal demand, and any reconsideration under Brazilian law.
